name: DataDeck
northStar: A case file for numbers: the figure and the cell it came from are one gesture apart.

manila.role: provenance only; spent nowhere else in either surface

elevation.note: There is no elevation anywhere. Separation is a 1px hairline; emphasis is a wash. A shadow, blur, gradient or translucent panel is a system violation, not a variant.

motion.note: Neither surface animates. The provenance reveal, the slide change and the step change are immediate state changes; nothing moves, so prefers-reduced-motion has nothing to disable and is honoured by construction.

rules: The manila rule: manila marks provenance and nothing else.
The word rule: colour never carries a state alone; every state also says its name in code type.
The narrow rule: Archivo Narrow marks machine identity only — codes, steps, column headers — never prose.
The rule rule: separate with hairlines, never with space, shadow or rounding.
dos: Use a token for every colour, size and rule width.
Keep tabular numerals on every figure.
Keep the provenance reveal operable by keyboard and announce what it revealed.
Keep a rejected claim in the app and out of the deck.
donts: No shadows, gradients, blur, rounded corners or pill shapes.
Never spend manila on decoration, headings or the band.
Never set prose in Archivo Narrow.
Never introduce a second saturated field colour.
